name: Cosmic Ray Watch
description: Cosmic rays rain down on Earth all the time. Leave the detector on and record their muons.

name: Test Beam
description: Try out new detector parts in a beam of particles from the SPS.

name: Physics School
description: Two weeks of lectures in the mountains. Everyone comes back smarter, and with a tan.

name: Proton Run
description: Fill the LHC with protons and collide them for twenty minutes.

name: Heavy-Ion Run
description: Collide lead nuclei to make tiny drops of quark-gluon plasma.

name: Antimatter Run
description: Slow antiprotons down in the Antiproton Decelerator and trap them.

name: Neutrino Beam
description: Send a beam of neutrinos straight through the Earth to a detector far away.

name: Long Physics Run
description: Keep the beams colliding all night, and come back in the morning to a mountain of data.
